title: Rozgar manual job
description: Ek local/employer job. data/manual-jobs.json ek array hai in objects ka. Sirf title aur company lazmi hain; baqi jitna bharein ge, poster aur detail page utna behtar banega.

title.description: Job ka asli title, jaise 'Assistant Manager Finance'. BPS ho to sath likhein: 'Stenographer (BPS-14)'.

company.description: Employer ka naam. Poster card ke liye chhota rakhein.

employer_display.description: Poora official naam jo detail page par dikhega, jaise 'Ministry of Information Technology & Telecom'.

location.description: Shehar, province ya 'Remote — Pakistan'. Default: Pakistan.

sector.description: Poster ka colour scheme isi se chunta hai.

category.description: Khali chhorein to title se khud detect ho jati hai.

level.description: Junior / Mid / Senior / Lead — ya khali.

qualification.description: Jaise 'MBA / M.Com' ya 'Matric'. Poster ke JOB DETAILS grid mein aata hai.

vacancies.description: Kitni posts hain. '03' ya 3 — dono chalega.

salary.description: Jo dikhana hai, wahi likhein: 'PKR 90,000 – 130,000 / month'.

salary_min.description: Google for Jobs ke liye — sirf number.

last_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Guzar jaye to job khud hat jati hai.

how_to_apply.description: Apply karne ka tareeqa — poster ke 'HOW TO APPLY' box mein chhapta hai.

apply_url.description: Online apply ka link (form, portal, ya employer ki site).

description.description: Job ki tafseel. 100+ words best — Google isi ko rank karta hai.

source_url.description: Agar job kisi aur site se li gayi hai to original ad ka link — attribution ke liye.

employer_submitted.description: true = employer ne khud bheja (site par 'Employer' dikhega).
